entries.name: Improved Gouge
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by $/1000;S1 sec.

entries.name: Remorseless Attacks
entries.descriptionTemplate: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a $m1% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts $14143d.

entries.name: Malice
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by $s1%.

entries.name: Ruthlessness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your finishing moves a $m1% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

entries.name: Murder
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases all damage dealt by $m1% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

entries.name: Improved Slice and Dice
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by $s1%.

entries.name: Relentless Strikes
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your finishing moves have a $m1% chance per Combo Point to restore $14181s1 Energy.

entries.name: Improved Expose Armor
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by $m1, and refunds $m2 Combo $LPoint:Points; when cast with $m3 Combo Points.

entries.name: Lethality
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Vile Poisons
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by $m1% and gives your poisons an additional $m3% chance to resist dispel effects.

entries.name: Cold Blood
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Poisons
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by $m1%, and gives Poison applications a $m2% chance to not consume a charge.

entries.name: Vigor
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your maximum Energy by $s1.

entries.name: Mutilate
entries.descriptionTemplate: Instantly attacks with both weapons for $1310706s2% weapon damage plus an additional ${$1310706m1*$1310706m2/100} with each weapon. Damage increased by $m4% against Poisoned targets. Awards $m1 Combo $LPoint:Points;.

entries.name: Improved Kidney Shot
entries.descriptionTemplate: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take $s1% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

entries.name: Seal Fate
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a $m1% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

entries.name: Venom
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by $m2% and your chance to apply Poisons by $m4%. Lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point  : 9 sec
   2 points: 12 sec
   3 points: 15 sec
   4 points: 18 sec
   5 points: 21 sec

entries.name: Improved Eviscerate
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Sinister Strike
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by $s1.

entries.name: Lightning Reflexes
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Dodge chance by $s1%.

entries.name: Puncturing Wounds
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by $m1% and your Mutilate by $m3%, and gives Backstab a $m2% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

entries.name: Deflection
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Parry chance by $s1%.

entries.name: Precision
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to hit by $s1%.

entries.name: Endurance
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by $m1%.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.descriptionTemplate: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.  This attack deals $s1% weapon damage and disarms the target for $19718d.

entries.name: Improved Sprint
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives a $m1% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

entries.name: Improved Kick
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Kick ability a $m1% chance to Silence the target for $18425d.

entries.name: Flawless Execution
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by $m1.

entries.name: Dual Wield Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by $s1%.

entries.name: Blade Flurry
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your melee attack speed by $s1% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts $d.

entries.name: Hack and Slash
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

    |CFFFFFFFFAxe/Sword:|R Your successful
    melee attacks have a $s3% chance
    to trigger an extra attack on the 
    target.

    |CFFFFFFFFDagger/Fist:|R Increases your
    critical strike chance by $s1%.

    |CFFFFFFFFMace:|R Your attacks ignore $s2% of
    your target's armor.

entries.name: Weapon Expertise
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by $m1%.

entries.name: Aggression
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by $s1% for $d.

entries.name: Camouflage
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by $s1% and reduces its cooldown by $/1000;s2 sec.

entries.name: Master of Deception
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were ${$m1/5} $llevel:levels; higher.

entries.name: Opportunity
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Setup
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging one of their attacks or fully resisting one of their spells.

entries.name: Elusiveness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by $/1000;S1 sec.

entries.name: Dirty Tricks
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Ambush
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by $s1%.

entries.name: Initiative
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $s1% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

entries.name: Ghostly Strike
entries.descriptionTemplate: A strike that deals $s1% ($m4% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by $s2% for $d.  Awards $s3 combo $lpoint:points;.

entries.name: Improved Distract
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by $s1 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional ${$m2/-5} $Llevel:levels; lower.

entries.name: Heightened Senses
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were ${$m1/5} $llevel:levels; higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by $m2%.

entries.name: Premeditation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Adds $s1 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within $d or the combo points are lost.

entries.name: Serrated Blades
entries.descriptionTemplate: Causes your attacks to ignore $m1% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by $m2%.

entries.name: Dirty Deeds
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by $m1, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

entries.name: Preparation
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

entries.name: Hemorrhage
entries.descriptionTemplate: An instant strike that deals $m4% weapon damage ($m5% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take $m3% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts $d. Awards $s2 Combo $lPoint:Points;.

entries.name: Quietus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause $m1% more damage against targets below $m2% health.

entries.name: Cutthroat
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Backstab has a $m1% chance to cause your next Ambush within $462707d to not require Stealth.

entries.name: Thousand Cuts
entries.descriptionTemplate: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within $1310723d is reduced by $1310723s1, stacking up to $1310723u times.
